I bought these mainly for dresses and special events, and they do the job well. They’re really useful for keeping necklines in place, securing straps or preventing clothes from shifting throughout the day. I think they’re one of those things that are great to have on hand for weddings, parties or any outfit that needs a little extra support.The tape sticks well and stays in place, which is exactly what you want. However, my main issue was that the adhesive can be difficult to remove from clothing. On one dress, it left residue behind and I wasn’t able to get it out completely, even after washing it.Overall, they’re handy for occasional use and can definitely save the day in certain situations, but I would be careful when using them on delicate or expensive fabrics.
